pr_body: Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/117054 by partially reverting https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/111495 and using `-nested` as a filter for the `_field_caps` call.
pr_title: ESQL: use field_caps native nested fields filtering
pr_comment: Hi @astefan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
There are no new commits on the base branch.

review_comment: Forgot to add a comment in the PR at this line; this is, indeed, the meat of the fix. I wasn't aware  field_caps has `-nested`, learned yesterday about it. Very useful :-D.
Is this an error because ES|QL does not yet support nested queries, and if we did we'd need special syntax for it?

I expect we will indeed need a special syntax for it.

For now I think we should do our best to ignore `nested` fields. One day we will have to do something with them, but it'll be some kind of nested join syntax or something.
